# Zeno

> Zeno is a subscription tracker and budgeting app for people who refuse to hand a bank login to an app. It finds subscriptions from email receipts you scan or a bank statement CSV you import, warns you 7 days, 3 days and the morning before each renewal, flags free trials before they convert, and gives step-by-step cancellation guides. A cancellation stays pending until the next renewal passes without a charge. Data is stored encrypted on the device; an account is optional. No bank login required.

Pricing (USD, via the App Store and Google Play): Free for up to 10 subscriptions, including reminders, cancellation guides and a monthly budget cap. Pro $3.99/month or $29.99/year adds unlimited subscriptions, category budgets and envelopes. Lifetime $79.99, one payment.
